title: Neo4j backend: delete the eval projects and prove Neo4j is clean

cases.title: no CbmNode rows remain for the eval projects
cases.cypher: MATCH (n:CbmNode) WHERE n.db STARTS WITH $prefix RETURN count(n)

cases.title: no CbmProject rows remain for the eval projects
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject) WHERE p.name STARTS WITH $prefix RETURN count(p)

cases.title: the indexes outlive the projects (shared schema objects)
cases.cypher: SHOW INDEXES YIELD name WHERE name STARTS WITH 'cbm_node_' RETURN count(name)

cases.title: local files are gone: db, marker, delta state
cases.shell: {{python}} -c "import os,sys; b=sys.argv[1]; print('left', [s for s in ('', '.graph.json', '.neo4j-state.db') if os.path.exists(b+s)])" "{{db_path}}"
